summary_en: Daiwabo Holdings cancelled 2,978,435 shares on October 30, 2026, reducing issued shares to 85,500,593. The cancellation comprised shares acquired through a market buyback programme (May 14 – October 16, 2026) and existing treasury shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Number of Treasury Shares to be Cancelled
translation_en_brief:
On October 8, 2026, Daiwabo Holdings announced the completion of treasury share cancellation. The company cancelled 2,978,435 shares as of October 30, 2026, reducing issued shares (excluding treasury shares) from 88,479,028 to 85,500,593 shares. This represents 3.4% of the pre-cancellation issued share count.

The cancelled shares comprised two components: shares acquired through a market buyback programme authorised by the board on May 13, 2026 (which operated from May 14 to October 16, 2026 with a ceiling of 2,400,000 shares and 6 billion yen), and 1,287,035 treasury shares already held by the company. The board resolution on May 13, 2026 approved cancellation of all newly acquired treasury shares together with a portion of existing treasury holdings.
